organization: IIIT Pune and i4C Sign MoU
description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) and the Inter Institutional Inclusive Innovations Center (i4C) to strengthen the institute-wide innovation ecosystem, foster students' curiosity and employability, introduce innovative approaches to curriculum-based learning, empower student clubs, and guide students in participating in the Smart India Hackathon and other hackathon initiatives.

organization: IIIT Pune and SGPGIMS Lucknow Sign MoU
description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) and the Sanjay Gandhi Postgraduate Institute of Medical Sciences (SGPGIMS), Lucknow, to collaborate on artificial intelligence-driven healthcare research, innovation, and education, fostering interdisciplinary collaboration and the development of AI-based healthcare solutions.

organization: IIIT Pune and IIT Bombay Sign MoU
description: Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) between the Indian Institute of Technology Bombay (IIT Bombay) and the Indian Institute of Information Technology Pune (IIIT Pune) to promote academic collaboration, research, faculty and student exchange, joint projects, internships, workshops, seminars, and other mutually beneficial activities in education and innovation.

organization: IIIT Pune Signs MoU with TrustLab, IIT Bombay
description: IIIT Pune has signed a Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) with TrustLab, IIT Bombay to collaborate in the areas of Cyber Security and Digital Trust. The partnership aims to promote research, innovation, knowledge sharing, and skill development, while preparing future-ready professionals to address emerging cybersecurity challenges.
